evidence.title: BERHANE OS — E-PSM Architecture and Prototyping
evidence.label: Public project
evidence.description: BERHANE OS is the architecture and prototyping layer built on the E-PSM market-design blueprint. It represents the design and software-development phase of the E-PSM lineage: Dual-Sided Failure diagnosis → Innovation Bridge → E-PSM market architecture → BERHANE OS design and prototyping → public software demonstrations (PISCES 2.0, Sovereign Studio). BERHANE OS is not a licensed financial market infrastructure, live exchange, central bank system, CSD, or blockchain. No regulatory approval, institutional adoption, or live operation is established. The ECMA dossier submission (ENG-002) is a separate engagement record.
evidence.source: E-PSM research manuscript (Academia.edu, author self-published December 2025); public implementations available on GitHub

evidence.title: PISCES 2.0 — E-PSM Institutional Market Prototype
evidence.label: Verified public demo
evidence.description: Public interactive prototype implementing the E-PSM institutional market architecture. Built on the BERHANE OS design lineage. The prototype demonstrates issuer analysis and readiness screening, deterministic Institutional Market Maker (IMM) scoring, illustrative auction workflow, capital structuring views, and a regulatory-observer interface — all using synthetic data only. There is no live securities exchange, live trading, real securities issuance, real settlement, regulatory approval, external credit rating, or integration with any institutional or financial infrastructure.
evidence.source: Public Vercel demo and public GitHub repository
evidence.deploymentState: Live public demo using synthetic data; no institutional or financial integration

evidence.title: BERHANE OS Sovereign Studio
evidence.label: Verified public demo
evidence.description: Public synthetic architecture and simulation laboratory built on the BERHANE OS design. There is no live banking integration, central-bank connection, CSD linkage, blockchain, or regulatory integration. No live settlement or institutional operation is established.
evidence.source: Public Vercel demo and public GitHub repository
evidence.deploymentState: Live public demo using synthetic data; no institutional or financial integration
